State & Actions \\

COMPLETED & \texttt{entry: mode\_motor = ModeMotors.Off; is\_extruding = false; request\_heated\_nozzle = false;} \\
IN\_PROGRESS & \texttt{entry: request\_heated\_nozzle = true;} \\
\quad PRINT\_PATH & \texttt{entry: mode\_motor = ModeMotors.GoTo; is\_extruding = true; command\_x = p.path(k, 1); command\_y = p.path(k, 2);} \\
\quad TRAVEL\_TO\_START & \texttt{entry: mode\_motor = ModeMotors.GoTo; is\_extruding = false; command\_x =p.path(max(k-1,1),1); command\_y = p.path(max(k-1,1),2);} \\
\quad WAIT\_HOT & \texttt{entry: mode\_motor = ModeMotors.Off; is\_extruding = false;} \\
IDLE & \texttt{entry: mode\_motor=ModeMotors.Off; is\_extruding = false; command\_x = 0; command\_y=0; request\_heated\_nozzle = false; paused = false;} \\
FAILED & \texttt{entry:mode\_motor = ModeMotors.Off; is\_extruding = false; request\_heated\_nozzle = false;} \\
PAUSED & \texttt{entry: paused = true; saved\_x = state.x; saved\_y = state.y; mode\_motor = ModeMotors.GoTo; command\_x = saved\_x; command\_y = saved\_y; is\_extruding = false; request\_heated\_nozzle=false;} \\
